_comment: FFX-2 mod text per game text language ([0xDD0210]+4: 0 jp, 1 en, 2 fr, 3 sp, 4 de, 5 it, 9 kr, 10 ch; FUN_00439630). ON/OFF as the game Config page writes them (menu_txt). ASCII in jp/kr/ch is written full-width. Regenerate x2_text_strings.h with tools/gen_text_x2.py (G:\Work fx2-fps60). Rewordings vs the FFX mod: kr reset, jp idle, ch fps (the FFX-2 glyph tables lack 셋 / 待 / 秒).
